description: FREE, NO KEY, NO SIGNUP: Run a real live demonstration against the official GOV.UK VAT rates source. Returns its official URL, government content identifier, source timestamp, fetched text excerpt, a SHA-256 digest and a quote-presence check. Uses one fixed public example; it does NOT claim historical changes or replace UKSI monitored snapshots. For historical change tasks prefer get_govuk_change_brief; this tool only checks current VAT text.

quote.description: Optional quotation to check in the GOV.UK VAT rates page, max 200 characters. If omitted, checks a built-in example.

name: preview_source_evidence
